mini_task_spec:
For each of the 9 sub-packages in `test-repo/packages/` (directories: `common`, `core`, `microservices`, `platform-express`, `platform-fastify`, `platform-socket.io`, `platform-ws`, `testing`, `websockets`), read the `name` and `version` fields from their respective `package.json` file and report them.

Use the `bat:parallel` tool (or equivalent batch parallel execution) to fetch all 9 `package.json` files simultaneously, then extract the `name` and `version` from each.

**Expected answer format**: one line per package, sorted by directory name (alphabetical), in the format `<npm-package-name>=<version>`. Example line: `@nestjs/common=11.1.19`.

Do NOT hardcode values — read them from the actual files under `test-repo/packages/<dir>/package.json`.

---
